description: Schema for observability/agent-runs/*.json — records of agent execution sessions (L11 Harness Engineering)

field_types.session_id: string — unique identifier for the agent session (e.g. UUID or date-prefixed slug)
field_types.skill: string — name of the genesis skill invoked
field_types.phase: string — one of: init, plan, execute, verify, handoff
field_types.outcome: string — one of: success, failure, partial, skipped
field_types.evidence: string — CLI output snippet or file path proving the outcome

optional_fields.task_id: string — task item from task.md this run belongs to
optional_fields.duration_ms: number — wall-clock time of the session
optional_fields.recovery_needed: boolean — whether a recovery point was consulted

changelog.change: Initial schema — establishes observability as first-class harness artifact per L11
